records.prompt: Create a finished raster GAMEPLAY FLOOR MAP, not a screenshot or concept illustration. A single underground shinobi military stronghold ENTRY HALL room, exact aspect ratio 7:5, image edge to image edge is 7 equally sized floor columns by 5 rows. Camera strictly straight overhead orthographic looking directly down, same perspective as a professionally painted RPG sector map. No horizon, no isometric tilt, no perspective foreshortening, no visible vertical faces of furnishings. High quality detailed hand painted realistic game environment, restrained dark aged limestone/slate, warm timber, aged bronze, muted crimson heraldry, soft motivated pools of amber light, clean playable composition. Small irregular stone flagstones with natural wear, meticulously joined stonework and an understated rectangular perimeter band embedded in floor; visually detailed but not noisy. This is an architectural gatehouse, not an empty arena with isolated props. The ONLY physical obstructions are two wall-integrated guard equipment alcoves: rectangle A x=1/7 to3/7,y=0 to1/5; rectangle B x=4/7 to6/7,y=0 to1/5 (top row of map, two mirrored bays). Each alcove is a built-in thick stone frame, compact timber locker and neatly folded red guard cloth, small recessed lantern cast into its frame. All raised parts and their shadows contained in those exact two rectangular bays. They meet the north edge and read as integrated station architecture. Everything else is open level walkable floor, including central third column lane and middle row lane, all four midpoint edges. Zero free standing props, no bed, no human, no NPC, no door placed on floor, no printed labels, no text, no UI, no border outside image, no giant seal or repeated center diamond. Floor occupies the full 7:5 canvas; no thick exterior walls inside this map. Make this visually as coherent and clean as a polished RPG painted overworld sector floor, rich believable materials, not 3D asset cutouts pasted onto tiles.
